name: Glow & Clean Charcoal Face Wash | Deep Cleansing Oil Control & Pore Care
description:
Experience the ultimate facial care with Glow & Clean Charcoal Face Wash. Enriched with activated charcoal, this daily cleanser deeply purifies skin, minimizes pores, controls excess oil, removes blackheads, and eliminates sebum buildup. Suitable for both men and women, it helps reveal a fresh, radiant, and healthy-looking complexion every day.
Key Features:
 Activated charcoal for deep cleansing
 Minimizes pores & refines skin texture
 Controls excess oil & sebum
 Effectively removes blackheads & impurities
 Suitable for daily use for men & women
 Promotes glowing, healthy skin
How to Use:
 Wet face with lukewarm water
 Apply a small amount and gently massage in circular motions
 Rinse thoroughly and pat dry
 Use twice daily for best results
Ingredients:
Activated Charcoal, Aqua, Glycerin, Aloe Vera Extract, Natural Cleansing Agents
Safety Information:
 For external use only
 Avoid direct contact with eyes
 Discontinue if irritation occurs
 Store in a cool, dry place
Package Includes:
 1 × Glow & Clean Charcoal Face Wash
